title: 1100-Watt Microwave Burned Popcorn, Scorched Popper in 90 Seconds
text:
1100-Watt Microwave Burned Popcorn, Scorched Popper in 90 Seconds. When I tested this MICROWAVE SILICONE POPCORN POPPER (Single Serve Portion, 2-piece (Blue & Red)) in an 1100-watt microwave, the popcorn burned and smoked up my kitchen. I used rather old popcorn (dry), enough to just cover the bottom of the popper. (This amount of popcorn did NOT fill the popper to the “maximum” line.)

After only 90 seconds, the popcorn was burned, and the silicone popper was scorched near the bottom, both inside and outside. (See photos.) Since the instructions suggest heating the popper for 2-4 minutes, the popper seems like a potential fire hazard.

The popcorn did pop. Experimentation with lower cook power and even shorter cooking times may produce edible popcorn. However, it’s not worth the trouble, as the single serving is only about 1½ cups of popcorn.
